notes: The variant unit on s025 is underdetermined and its fallback remains among the readings the English permits, so it is aligned as ordinary text; rule 53 does not reach it.
Each of the three ʿôḏ tokens has English of its own ('more', 'any more', 'at all'), so none is a repetition to mark unrepresented.
'to them all' writes no 'of', so the suffix takes the bare pronoun and kōl keeps only 'all' (rule 19's last clause).
